review_basis:
Eighteenth golden, a third and much simpler candidate on the same VA Durham sheet M-401 that already yielded two triple-stacked-pipe goldens -- this one a single, unstacked system, found via the same sheet's own full text scan turning up a `4" GLR` (glycol return) callout in a completely different area (a glycol pump bank elsewhere on the sheet). A render crop shows a real, simple 4-inch glycol-return vertical riser: from a real butterfly-valve connection at the top (the sheet's own printed 'BUTTERFLY VALVE EACH PUMP' note, with a leader pointing directly at the real valve symbol) straight down to a real pump connection at the bottom (a drawn pump symbol) -- no stacking, no crowded parallel-line ambiguity, the cleanest single-line candidate on this sheet.

`trace_run` reaches this riser cleanly (9.33 LF, matching the visible span) with a real `branch_joins_main` stop at the top (a new stop-reason category for this session's own corpus, genuinely appropriate here -- the valve is where this riser branches off the header main serving each pump) and a real `ambiguous` stop at the bottom (the pump connection, a genuine multi-directional real fitting). Both endpoints confirmed via marked render crop sitting exactly on the drawn valve and pump symbols. This file's own file-wide missing-PDF-layer-names cause (already established by this project's own first two goldens) applies here too -- a manual size override is used, per that same precedent. The run's own bench-style reseed (40% into its single segment) was independently re-verified live and reproduces the identical result.
